defect: Pair endpoint resolution could not create a direct segment-bound subject relation; component validators still expected original lineage IDs.
correction: Added explicit PAIR_PROJECTION authority and rewired components and internal pairs.

defect: Proposition-only bridges and orphan attachments had no deterministic candidate grouping algorithm.
correction: Added deterministic meta-graph grouping and a 22-group real-topology preflight.

defect: Candidate members could not be reconstructed exactly from components and attachments.
correction: Added immutable origin keys, attachment projections, membership basis, and origin validation.

defect: One candidate_family_id could not represent overlapping base and attachment-review participation.
correction: Replaced the one-candidate assumption with CANDIDATE_PARTICIPANT and many-to-many membership authority.

defect: Schema-valid packets could contain mismatched members, pair counts, summaries, rankings, hashes, or decisions.
correction: Delivered an executable semantic validator and mutation tests.

defect: Completed decisions did not necessarily disposition every proposed member exactly once.
correction: Added exact member-partition validation and canonical membership closure.

defect: Split points did not create executable successor candidate groups.
correction: Added stable split-result candidates and exact disjoint member partitions.

defect: Candidate variants and exclusions could not safely become canonical authority under immutable ownership.
correction: Added explicit variant and exclusion promotion mappings into canonical-owned authority.

defect: Full signatures were required for 3,296 pair-incident lineages although only 399 participate in proposition authority.
correction: Bounded initial full signatures to 399, preserved constraint evidence for 2,897, and deferred 10,230 without declaring them unique or irrelevant.
Replaced them with nonzero deterministic NONAUTHORITY_TEST_FIXTURE hashes and a semantic guard.

defect: Completed decisions and status events lacked complete temporal event fields across JSON and SQL.
correction: Added created_at and occurred_at fields and validation.

defect: The real 658-edge topology had not been converted into a deterministic candidate-origin preflight.
correction: Delivered the 94 strict + 25 proposition-only seed + 22 attachment-review = 141 pre-signature diagnostic inventory.

defect: Two content-addressed object schemas contradicted the governed identity registry.
correction: Aligned schema patterns and identity allocation rules to one canonical serialization and ID strategy.

defect: Variant and adjudication revisions lacked normalized persistent ordinals.
correction: Added explicit revision ordinals, uniqueness, and supersession constraints.

defect: Split, hierarchical, and unresolved decisions had JSON forms but incomplete normalized SQL persistence.
correction: Added status-specific child tables and completeness validators.

defect: A draft projection constraint lexically reordered endpoints and could reverse directional authority.
correction: Removed lexical endpoint ordering; projection preserves governed left/right roles and orientation.

defect: A packet could cite a direct pair without carrying the projection record that proves selected subjects and pair provenance.
correction: Required explicit projection records in packets and cross-validated projection ID, endpoints, and underlying pair fact.

defect: Copied matching hash strings could pass even when the delivered evidence surface did not reproduce the hash.
correction: Defined the evidence-bundle serialization surface and recompute the SHA-256 from signatures, response references, projections, pair matrix, collisions, obligations, and evidence links.
